items.title: TJX Just Dropped 11% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell?
items.summary: TJX beat estimates, raised guidance, and expanded margins, yet the stock shed 11% in a month while its closest rival surged 34% year to date. The split between what the business delivered and what investors did next tells a complicated story about where the risk actually sits.

items.title: Kohl’s Falls 6% Despite Raised Guidance and a $150M Tariff Refund, Ross and TJX Hold Flat
items.summary: Kohl's posted a blowout earnings beat and raised its full-year outlook, yet shares are cratering while rivals Ross and TJX barely flinch. The reason buried inside the margin numbers may explain why investors are refusing to celebrate.

items.title: Bears are Losing Control Over TJX (TJX), Here's Why It's a 'Buy' Now
items.summary: After losing some value lately, a hammer chart pattern has been formed for TJX (TJX), indicating that the stock has found support. This, combined with an upward trend in earnings estimate revisions, could lead to a trend reversal for the stock in the near term.
